usage: agentbreeder services [-h]
                             {up,plan,status,logs,usage,start,stop,restart,env,down}
                             ...

positional arguments:
  {up,plan,status,logs,usage,start,stop,restart,env,down}
    up                  Start the stack and write its demo config
    plan                Show the grant `up` would ask to confirm (starts
                        nothing)
    status              Show the stack's services
    logs                Show a service's logs (redacted)
    usage               Show the stack's CPU, memory, network, block IO and
                        disk use
    start               Start one service's existing container
    stop                Stop one service's container (keeps it and its data)
    restart             Restart one service's container (only that one)
    env                 Print exports for the stack's config
    down                Stop the stack (keeps data and secrets)

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
